title: How do I book an appointment?
content: To book an appointment, go to the Book Appointment page on the website, choose a service, select your pet, then pick a date and time slot. You'll get a confirmation once it's booked. You can also ask this chatbot to start a booking for you.

title: What are your clinic hours?
content: Animal World Hospital is open Saturday to Thursday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and Friday from 2:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Our emergency line is available 24/7.

title: Can I cancel or reschedule a booking?
content: Yes. Go to your Profile page, open the Bookings tab, select the booking, and use the Reschedule or Cancel buttons. You can also contact the care team directly from the booking detail page.

title: Do you offer home delivery for shop orders?
content: Yes, we deliver products ordered from the shop. During checkout you drop a pin for your delivery location and add your address details; a driver is assigned and you can track the order status from your profile.

title: What payment methods do you accept?
content: We currently support cash on visit and cash on delivery for shop orders. Online payment integration is coming soon.

title: Do you treat exotic pets?
content: Our vets primarily treat dogs and cats. For exotic pets (birds, reptiles, small mammals) please call the clinic directly so we can confirm availability of a specialist.
